round: VoiceDesign 2 · acoustic casting · 12 candidates per character
note: Four supplied descriptions per character, independently sampled three times each with model defaults. Direct VoiceDesign dialogue only; no narrator, reference audio, conversion, cloning or training. Candidate labels are neutral; exact descriptions, seeds and settings are in details. Earlier rounds remain available. No casting is selected automatically.

voices.name: Candidate 01
voices.description: Prompt A · independent sample 1 · Direct VoiceDesign with model defaults. An American man in his mid-thirties, speaking in a medium register with lean, slightly nasal resonance, dry vocal grain, and a faint creak at phrase endings. Relaxed consonants and connected conversational speech, with an unhurried setup followed by quick stressed words and short falling endings. Wry, mildly impatient amusement, speaking casually to someone he knows well.

voices.text:
Well, the cantina's still standing.

Found your secret station. Found some recordings. Nearly got killed by a security droid.

Listen, sweetheart. We found something about Darren.

Don't thank me yet. I haven't sent you the bill.

Sounds like a real person speaking spontaneously rather than a trained audiobook narrator.

voices.description: Prompt A · independent sample 1 · Direct VoiceDesign with model defaults. voices.text:
How did it go?

That's encouraging.

Are you hurt?

Of course he did,

Han, I want you to bring those files back.

We can send a proper intelligence team later. Those records may explain what happened to Darren.

Thank you.

Come home, Han.
